headline: Public hearings on eight projects, including 205 St. James Avenue and 77 Maple Street, with roof vents, signs, fences, windows, and two violation cases.
summary: Five new public hearings and three continued hearings are listed. Items include a front door, a heat pump, exterior repairs, roof vents, signs, fences, and windows, plus two violation cases.
items: 205 St. James Avenue: front door (continued public hearing)
33 Madison Avenue: heat pump (continued public hearing)
77 Maple Street: various exterior repairs and renovations (continued public hearing; property also has a preservation restriction held by the Massachusetts Historical Commission)
59 Ingersoll Grove: roof vent (new public hearing)
46 Oxford Street: roof vent (new public hearing)
22 Cornell Street: fence, in re violation (new public hearing)
24 Beechwood Avenue: windows and elimination of windows, in re violation (new public hearing)
Our Lady of the Rosary Local Historic District Study Committee
